column3: coresight: Fix address filters for vmas with non-zero offset

column2: the address range calculation for file-based filters works as

column1: long as the vma that maps the matching part of the object file starts
from offset zero into the file (vm_pgoff==0). Otherwise
filter range would be off by vm_pgoff pages. Another related problem is
that in case of a partially matching vma

column2: the filter range size wouldn't be adjusted.

column1: Fix the arithmetics around address filter range calculations

column2: so that the entire calculation is done before

column1: the filter configuration is passed to the PMU drivers instead of having
those drivers do the final bit of arithmetics.
Based on the patch by Adrian Hunter <adrian.hunter.intel.com>.
